data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of $225,755,000 (2016: $142,768,000) is a deterioration of $5,582,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year (2016: release $3,362,000).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant large losses during the 2016 calendar year impacted 2015 policies that were on risk; contributed to adverse development on earlier years.
Increase in US weather related events in 2016, mostly in respect of flood and hail losses, adversely affected development of 2016 and earlier years.

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and two Mexican earthquakes (combined)
named_events.loss_description: The total net cost of these five events for the 2017 calendar year is $68.8m; these events affected Property D&F and contributed to a significant loss for the syndicate.
Hurricane Matthew and several flood and hail events in 2016 increased claims experience for the 2016 year.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $230.962m. During 2017 the syndicate experienced net adverse prior-year development of approximately $9.5m (gross), mainly driven by deterioration in property-related reserves following numerous US and Caribbean natural catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and two Mexican earthquakes) and adverse habitational weather losses. This was partially offset by favourable development in selected casualty lines. The total net cost of the five major 2017 events was reported at $68.8m (net).
raw_causal_phrases: The number of significant catastrophe events during 2017, rather than the severity of any individual event, impacted both the 2016 and 2017 years of account negatively
These events have contributed to a significant loss for the syndicate
Included within net claims incurred of $225,755,000 (2016: $142,768,000) is a deterioration of $5,582,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year (2016: release $3,362,000).
The total net cost of these five events for the 2017 calendar year is $68.8m
The performance of the property classes has been reduced by the large number of weather related losses on habitational business.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Report is denominated in USD; field names with '_gbp_m' are retained in schema but amounts are reported in the native currency (USD millions). The narrative note quoted in the accounts ($5.582m deterioration) is NET of reinsurance; per requirements the prior-year development used here is the GROSS movement derived from the gross claims development table. Reinsurance-to-close items exist for underwriting year accounts (2015 closure) but do not materially invalidate the gross claims development triangle used for prior-year calculation.
